expectations.text: The reply identifies that the upper bound (x > hi returning hi) is not tested, ideally by showing that a mutation of that line still passes
expectations.evidence: The reply says "Values above `hi`... Line 3 of `clamp.js` (`if (x > hi) return hi;`) never runs" and gives a mutation table where "Upper-bound check deleted | pass" shows the suite still passes when that line is broken.
